create_programs_database: create a ProgramsDatabase with config, template, and function name to evolve programs across islands
get_prompt_from_database: get a Prompt with code and version from a random island in the ProgramsDatabase
register_program_in_database: register a program with scores into a specific island or all islands in the database
reset_weaker_islands: reset the weaker half of islands and seed them with founders from stronger islands
sample_program_from_cluster: sample a program from a Cluster with higher probability given to shorter programs
